1	// B7: doctest for the QEMU-plugin V-drain decision function.
2	//
3	// The plugin's V-state drain used to gate on `v->vlenb` (the register
4	// handle truthiness) AND `s.vlenb > 0`. The combination silently omits
5	// the V block whenever the stub advertises some V state but not vlenb,
6	// confusing "stub broke" with "V disabled at runtime". This test pins
7	// the four-case truth table: SKIP when no V at all, ABORT when partial,
8	// SKIP when V advertised but disabled (vlenb=0), OK otherwise.
9	
10	#define DOCTEST_CONFIG_IMPLEMENT_WITH_MAIN
11	#include "doctest.h"
12	
13	#include "hybrid/v_drain_policy.h"
14	
15	TEST_CASE("no V advertised at all -> SKIP")
16	{
17	  CHECK(hybrid_v_drain_policy(/*has_vlenb=*/0, /*has_other_v=*/0,
18	                              /*vlenb_value=*/0)
19	        == HYBRID_V_DRAIN_SKIP);
20	}
21	
22	TEST_CASE("vlenb missing but vtype/vl/etc advertised -> ABORT")
23	{
24	  // The "broken stub" case the original gate hid. Don't silently emit a
25	  // zero-filled V block: the resume side then writes garbage into QEMU2.
26	  CHECK(hybrid_v_drain_policy(/*has_vlenb=*/0, /*has_other_v=*/1,
27	                              /*vlenb_value=*/0)
28	        == HYBRID_V_DRAIN_ABORT);
29	}
30	
31	TEST_CASE("vlenb advertised but value=0 -> SKIP (V disabled at runtime)")
32	{
33	  // QEMU may expose the V feature in XML even when V is not enabled in
34	  // the CPU at runtime; vlenb then reads 0. Treat as "no V live".
35	  CHECK(hybrid_v_drain_policy(/*has_vlenb=*/1, /*has_other_v=*/1,
36	                              /*vlenb_value=*/0)
37	        == HYBRID_V_DRAIN_SKIP);
38	}
39	
40	TEST_CASE("vlenb advertised, value>0 -> OK")
41	{
42	  CHECK(hybrid_v_drain_policy(/*has_vlenb=*/1, /*has_other_v=*/1,
43	                              /*vlenb_value=*/16)
44	        == HYBRID_V_DRAIN_OK);
45	  CHECK(hybrid_v_drain_policy(/*has_vlenb=*/1, /*has_other_v=*/1,
46	                              /*vlenb_value=*/64)
47	        == HYBRID_V_DRAIN_OK);
48	}
49	
50	TEST_CASE("vlenb advertised alone (no other V) is still ABORT-equivalent: "
51	          "policy treats vlenb-only as no V context")
52	{
53	  // Edge case: stub advertises vlenb but no other V regs. This is
54	  // unusual; treat as SKIP since we have no V data to actually drain.
55	  // (Documented behaviour, not a runtime failure mode QEMU emits.)
56	  CHECK(hybrid_v_drain_policy(/*has_vlenb=*/1, /*has_other_v=*/0,
57	                              /*vlenb_value=*/16)
58	        == HYBRID_V_DRAIN_SKIP);
59	}
